description.zh: 用户按下按钮、卡片等可点击元素时，元素轻微缩小（通常 0.95～0.98）， 松开后弹回。一个几十毫秒的细节，让界面"手感"立刻从网页变成实体按键。
description.en: When users press a clickable element it scales down slightly (typically 0.95–0.98) and springs back on release. A few tens of milliseconds that make a UI feel like physical buttons instead of flat web pages.

use_when.zh: 所有可点击元素：按钮、卡片、图标按钮
use_when.en: All tappable elements — buttons, cards, icon buttons

use_when.zh: 移动端与触屏界面（按压是最主要操作）
use_when.en: Touch-first interfaces where pressing is the primary gesture

use_when.zh: 需要"实体感"的产品调性
use_when.en: Products aiming for a tactile feel

avoid_when.zh: 大面积区域点击（整卡缩放会带动文字晃动）
avoid_when.en: Very large tap areas — scaling the whole card makes text wobble

avoid_when.zh: 列表行内小操作，避免整行抖动
avoid_when.en: Small inline actions inside rows — avoid whole-row jitter

avoid_when.zh: 已有其他强反馈（如下压阴影 + 填充动画）叠加过度
avoid_when.en: When stronger feedback already exists — avoid stacking effects

note.zh: 同时收小阴影，模拟"按下去"
note.en: Tighten shadow simultaneously to simulate pressing

note.zh: 不缩放，降低亮度，适合桌面
note.en: No scaling; dim instead — suits desktop

notes.zh: 用 :active 伪类配合 transition: transform 80ms；缩放原点默认中心。 松开的回弹可稍微放缓 transition（150ms）模拟弹簧。纯 CSS 即可实现，无需 JS。 移动端注意 :active 需要 touchstart 监听或 -webkit-tap-highlight 处理才能稳定触发。
notes.en: Use the :active pseudo-class with `transition: transform 80ms`; relax to ~150ms on release for a spring feel. Pure CSS suffices. On touch devices, :active can be flaky — add a touchstart listener or handle -webkit-tap-highlight.

basic.zh: 给按钮添加按压反馈：按下时轻微缩小，松开弹回。
basic.en: Add press feedback to buttons — a slight scale-down on press, springing back on release.

design.zh: 按钮按下时缩放到 0.96 并轻微收紧阴影，80ms 缩下、150ms 回弹，手感接近实体按键；触屏设备同样生效。
design.en: On press, scale the button to 0.96 and tighten its shadow; 80ms down, 150ms spring back — a tactile key feel that also works on touch devices.

implementation.zh: 用 CSS 实现：active:scale-[0.96] + transition-transform duration-75（下压）与恢复 150ms；阴影用 active:shadow-sm。确保触屏上 :active 生效（添加 touchstart 监听或 ontouchstart 属性 hack）。尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
implementation.en: CSS-only: `active:scale-[0.96]` with `transition-transform duration-75` down and ~150ms back; `active:shadow-sm`. Make :active reliable on touch (touchstart listener or the ontouchstart hack). Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中为所有可点击元素统一添加按压反馈。

先检查是否已有全局按钮样式或交互规范，保持一致。
要求：
- 按下 scale(0.96) + 阴影收紧，80ms 缩下 150ms 回弹
- 覆盖 Button 组件与可点击卡片
- 触屏设备可靠触发
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add unified press feedback to all clickable elements in the current project.

Check for existing global button styles first and stay consistent.
Requirements:
- scale(0.96) + tightened shadow on press; 80ms down, 150ms back
- Cover the Button component and clickable cards
- Reliable on touch devices
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.
